title: Base change of a surjective morphism is surjective
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a surjective morphism of schemes [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and $g:X'\to X$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the projection $Y\times_XX'\to X'$ from the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is surjective.

mathlib_searches.query: surjective morphisms of schemes are stable under base change

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: the instance `MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange @Surjective` (line 436) applied to the pullback square of $f$ along $g$ (`MorphismProperty.pullback_snd`) gives that `pullback.snd f g` is surjective
